title: Vista4D: Netflix Framework for 4D Video Reshooting
summary: Vista4D is a framework by Netflix’s Eyeline Labs for synthesizing existing video footage from entirely new camera trajectories using 4D point clouds. It combines 4D reconstruction with generative video models to enable post-production camera framing and scene recomposition.
research_notes: Developed by Eyeline Studios (Netflix) in collaboration with researchers from Columbia, UCLA, Stony Brook, and Oxford.

evolution.summary: Selected as a CVPR 2026 Highlight, Vista4D was released in April 2026 with open-source inference code and model weights (384p and 720p). It utilizes the Wan2.1-T2V-14B base model and is currently part of Netflix’s AI-driven filmmaking roadmap.
